sources: Owner-approved twin-valley story and art plan, 17 November 2026
name: Yamantaka

lines.text: You can come in. Leave the centre of the threshold open; the cook carries hot water through it.
Three heads, one household's share of work. Someone still has to mend the windbreak.
Mirlepa is watching the entrance. You may sit beside him or speak with whoever is at the hearth. There is no toll.
We keep the fold outside the sleeping place. Shelter has room for a visitor because someone leaves that room.

notes: Three anatomical heads, a specific fantastical person's feature, not a trait of all Denisovans. Kalash-inspired garments; peaceful guardian, no weapon or combat gate.
